explained.tdh.overview.meta.title: Total Days Held · 6529 Explained
explained.tdh.overview.meta.description: What TDH is, what it is for, and how it is checked every day.
explained.tdh.overview.title: Total Days Held
explained.tdh.overview.lede: Every card you hold adds its rate for each whole day held (rarer cards have a higher rate), one boost multiplies the total, and the result weighs your votes on the next Meme card.
explained.tdh.overview.machine.label: One copy, as an area
explained.tdh.overview.machine.copiesMin: {minted} minted so far · counts as {edition} · CC0
explained.tdh.overview.machine.tomorrow: Tomorrow's result adds {n}, rounded per card.
explained.tdh.overview.machine.sold: {sold} The days leave with the copy: the buyer starts at zero, and its first whole day counts a day after it arrives.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.label: The picture
explained.tdh.overview.picture.title: A copy's TDH is an area.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.body: Its {days} are the width. Its card's {rate} is the height: {h}, the largest Meme edition, divided by the card's own edition, so rarer cards stand taller. One {boost} lays a band across everything you hold.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.captionLe: Every edition has the same area.
explained.tdh.overview.picture.caption: A card's copies add about {h} TDH a day before boosts, whatever its size, so each new card adds about the same to the network. Real editions from 6529.io, read {read}.
explained.tdh.overview.network.label: Everyone's TDH
explained.tdh.overview.network.title: The network is one area too, and it is not spread evenly.
explained.tdh.overview.network.aria: Today's TDH as one area, split by rank: the top identities' share of the total, and their share of the identities.
explained.tdh.overview.network.caption: The top {count} identities hold {share} of today's TDH; an identity is one to four linked wallets, not always one person. The groups count the {ranked} identities 6529.io's API ranks with TDH above zero, so they add up to fewer than the identities the daily check compares. Read {read}.
explained.tdh.overview.network.unavailab: 6529.io's API did not answer, so this figure is not drawn.
explained.tdh.overview.weight.label: What it is for
explained.tdh.overview.weight.title: Your TDH is your weight here.
explained.tdh.overview.weight.body: TDH is not money. You cannot send it or spend it, and voting does not use it up. It is the say your collection gives you, and only holding earns it: the art itself is {cc0}, free for anyone to use.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.votesBody: Main Stage chooses each new Meme card, three times a week, by votes weighed by TDH.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.ratingsBody: Rep and NIC (Network Identity Check) are ratings collectors give each other, each up to your TDH plus your xTDH. xTDH is a separate score, never TDH: what other holders grant you, and what your own cards produce that you have not granted away.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.levelBody: Your Level grows with your TDH, your xTDH and the Rep others give you.
explained.tdh.overview.uses.validatorsBo: Validators will weigh each identity by its TDH when they sign a day. Their software, {version}, is being tested; nothing signs yet.
explained.tdh.overview.number.label: Your number
explained.tdh.overview.number.title: Is my number right?
explained.tdh.overview.number.body: Explain my TDH shows every copy that counted for you, your boost, and whether your record was equal in today's comparison.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.input: A profile, an ENS name or an address
explained.tdh.overview.explain.placehold: A profile, ENS name or address
explained.tdh.overview.explain.total: Base {base} × boost {boost} = {total}, in the result dated {date}.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.included: All three computations gave it the same TDH.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.includedE: For a real record, this line says whether the latest comparison included it and all three computations gave it the same TDH.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.notChecke: 6529.io computed this record at block {block}; the latest comparison checked block {cutoff}.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.error: 6529.io did not answer. Try again in a moment.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.errorEns: 6529.io found no wallet for {identity}, or did not answer. Check the spelling of the name, or paste the address.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.empty: This record holds no card that counts.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.newBody: No result has counted this wallet yet, and that is expected. Your copy of #{card} arrived {arrived}. The result dated {gapDate} found {gap}: not a whole day. The result dated {firstDate}, published about {publish}, counts its first whole day and adds {rate}; each day after adds {rate} more.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.timeline: Each line is a midnight UTC snapshot; a copy counts only whole days held.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.timelineA: A timeline of daily snapshots, the copy's arrival, and the first snapshot that counts a whole day.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.noneTitle: No wallet found by that name.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.noneBody: Check the spelling, or paste the address. If the wallet received its first card today, it appears in a result once it has held the card for a whole day.
explained.tdh.overview.explain.why: Why did my TDH change? Pick what happened
explained.tdh.overview.know.label: How we know
explained.tdh.overview.know.title: Checked every day, and published with the files to check its hashes.
explained.tdh.overview.know.body: Each rung rules out more than the one above; the blue line marks how far the evidence reaches today.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.writtenBody: P26 states the rules exactly enough that separately written programs agree to the unit.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.provedBody: Lean proofs about a Lean model of P26's rules, each with what it does not cover; the vectors test that the model matches P26. The same manifest holds {p53} more about the rules validators would follow (P53, a proposal), which use TDH as their weight.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.provedRef: {shownFalse} statements about TDH's rules shown false ({all} with the validator rules)
explained.tdh.overview.rung.dailyBody: Two separately written programs, the Rust core and the Python reference, equal 6529.io on every identity. The Rust core is the TDH part of program A below; the Python reference is never proved.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.dailyRefMiss: {equal} of {compared} results since {first}; none yet for {missing}
explained.tdh.overview.rung.inputsBody: Today public log servers supply the history, and nothing checks it against block headers yet.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.recordedBody: A contract would record a day only with both proofs. Built, tested on a copy of mainnet, not deployed.
explained.tdh.overview.rung.signedBody: Each validator would run programs A and B and sign a day only if they agree.
explained.tdh.overview.zk.lead: A proof can be checked without rerunning its program. The proof files are not public yet.
explained.tdh.overview.zk.lineA: Proof A, program A in SP1: proved the day of {date} under {version}, the rules' earlier version; mainnet's SP1 verifier accepts it in a read-only call.
explained.tdh.overview.zk.lineB: Proof B, program B in RISC Zero, written separately from A and from the Python reference: no mainnet day yet. Under TDH v1.4, programs A and B both proved one synthetic test cycle.
explained.tdh.overview.know.fail1: the public log servers reported Ethereum's history wrongly: all three computations read the same history, and 6529 runs all three, or
explained.tdh.overview.know.fail2: the rules themselves say something other than what 6529 means them to say.
explained.tdh.overview.know.closedBy: rung {inputs}, for the first. No rung closes the second; rung {proofs}, the Lean proofs, narrows it. The daily check cannot see either.
explained.tdh.overview.know.candour: A green day is a strong check, not a proof.
explained.tdh.overview.know.linkSure: What is proved, and what is not

explained.tdh.overview.hwk.feedBody: index.json, written {written}; read {read}. Each day file's SHA-256 is checked against the index.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.siteNetworkBo: The Meme editions, read {read}; everyone's TDH (tdh/consolidated_metrics), read at most an hour before the page.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.siteNetworkRe: The Meme editions, read {read}; everyone's TDH (tdh/consolidated_metrics), read {network}.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.siteSnapshotB: The Meme editions, read {read}. 6529.io's API did not answer for everyone's TDH, so the figure is the snapshot kept with the page, read {snapshot}.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.rulesBody: P26, TDH v1.4 ({repo} {commit}), private, restated on the Specification page; D112, D119, D125, D128, D136, D137 and D142, from the record through {newest}.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.figuresBody: Computed in your browser by the TDH v1.4 engine, which passes all {vectors} of P26's vectors.
explained.tdh.overview.hwk.proofsBody: Proof A of cycle {cycle}, accepted by mainnet's SP1 verifier in a read-only call at block {block}, from the validator's contracts record.
